name: @orchbee/terminal-host
description: Local authoritative terminal-execution service for Orchbee's trusted Desktop broker

scripts.format:check: zig fmt --check build.zig build.zig.zon src && node scripts/check-zig-file-size.mjs
scripts.test: zig build test && node scripts/run-protocol-conformance.mjs && node scripts/run-surface-fixture-conformance.mjs
scripts.test:cross: zig build test-compile -Dtarget=x86_64-linux-gnu -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe && zig build test-compile -Dtarget=x86_64-freebsd -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe && zig build test-compile -Dtarget=aarch64-macos -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe && zig build test-compile -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe
